details:
As the title says, we get issues where there are 2 instances up with the same ID, people will only be able to join the newer one, while their friends are still in the older one with a lot of people in it. Rejoining automatically puts you into the newer one.

This has been an issue for almost a year now to my knowledge.

CAUSE:

Not sure what exactly causes it, but for context: I run a large 24/7 group instance.

The instance is ALWAYS up with always at least over 20 people. And the almost only reason I'd close the instance is when this exact issue happens.

The bug most frequently happens after the instance automatically resets due to age.

The automatic reset usually works fine, but if were to guess: about somewhere between 1/10th ~ 1/20th of the time the bug occurs.

Just now it happened kind of randomly, although i suspect it could be related to today's US server issues.

DETAILS:

Most recent one was for the instance Group Public #PUG DWELLERS(Pug Dwellers)

Closed At: 15/01/2026, 16:51:52 (GMT+1)

Group ID: grp_36af8023-0449-4399-9e1d-dbea57aa90db

Not sure if you guys can look into past server logs but again, the only reason we close an instance is when this bug happens, or there are other server issues 

(except one time for Halloween when we had to make it group+ temporarily for an event)

Video showing the issue: 

https://files.catbox.moe/rwc752.mp4
title: Instance desync - 2 instances up with same ID
